name: Grove of the Ancients
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Level 17 instead of 11. Gives 1,250 experience instead of 875, 1.43 times as much. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, due south of Auberdine.

You will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.
narrative.objectives: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah. Thank you, adventurer. It is strange, though. The Arch Druid always seems in such a hurry. The forest knows that all shall come to pass in the appointed time. Shan'do Stormrage understood that.
narrative.requestItemsText: Ah. champion. How may Onu assist you?

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 11 to 17, 3,120 XP in all.

quests.name: The Enchanted Glade
quests.objectiveText: Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

quests.name: Darkness in the Glade
quests.objectiveText: Collect Hatescreech's Amulet, Windmistress Gaedress' Amulet, and Witchmother Arysa's Amulet for Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.

quests.name: The Oracle Tree
quests.objectiveText: Find the Oracle Tree Bark nearby to receive its message.

quests.name: Teldrassil
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Inscribed Bark to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

quests.name: Grove of the Ancients
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, south of Auberdine.
